text:
maddie (partnerships): Kickoff: NovaSystems + CloudX joint benchmark. Goal: reproducible perf-per-watt + sustained throughput narrative for marketplace listing and a technical collateral pack. 6-8 week target.

josh (nova-engineer): Nova can provide signed firmware, power sensor mappings, and fan-profile scripts. Need details on bench harness and artifact tagging.

sana (cloudx-eng): We'll coordinate marketplace metadata and ensure images meet CloudX registry policies. Also: region for runs? us-west for now.

anna (eng-runtime): Proposed workload matrix:
- real-time chat (4k tokens, interactive)
- embedding bulk (2k batch, 1536-d embeddings)
- extended context inference (64k memory test)
Measure: p95 latency, steady-state tokens/sec, watts (mean & 95th), and energy per token.

kevin (infra): Rack request: isolated VLAN + jump host. We need provider SSO for Nova and CloudX engineers. Lab ready in ~72 hours once approvals done.

ryan (eng-ml): Model pinning for repeatability: open-ggml-13B-v3 @ commit d4e5f6 and tokenizers v0.13. We'll publish a manifest with checksums and seed values for RNG. Quality gate: run 250 prompts, compare ROUGE/embedding cosine; threshold 97% similarity for acceptance.

carla (SI): We'll own the deployment templates (Terraform + Helm + a short validation playbook) and run one customer-mix test. Also will provide an incident checklist for the SI-run.

maddie (partnerships): Narrative pillars we want: 1) Kernel tuning yields X% perf/W uplift, 2) batching strategies scale throughput w/o regressing latency SLOs, 3) reproducible artifacts for marketplace customers. Who authors each?

anna (eng-runtime): I'll prepare the tuning appendix (kernel options, fused-KV notes, mixed-precision settings, perf counters to collect).

josh (nova-engineer): Nova will supply power CSVs, sensor mappings, fan profiles, and a short note on thermal headroom. We'll also provide a small pcie firmware change to test a fused-memband kernel.

kevin (infra): Prom endpoints: /metrics/power and /metrics/fan exposed on port 9100. We'll enable high-frequency scraping (2s) for the runs. Bench VM images will be labeled with bench tag.

bench-bot: queued job: nova-cloudx-crossbench-2146-setup. Monitoring targets: prom:9090, grafana: dash-2146, influx for short retention.

ryan (eng-ml): Add deterministic prompt suite and a blind quality run (labels withheld) so partner tuning doesn't inadvertently alter output semantics. If embedding cosine drops >0.03 average, fail.

maddie (partnerships): Draft timeline: week0: infra + image exchange; week1-2: kernel tuning sweeps; week3: scaled throughput runs; week4: stability/soak (8h+); week5: analysis + draft artifacts; week6-8: cross-review, legal/marketing, marketplace publish.

josh (nova-engineer): Need rack access approvals. Sending SSO IDs for two Nova engineers now.

carla (SI): I'll drop a runbook template here by EOD tomorrow. It will include: validation steps, metrics to capture, rollback criteria, and run ownership.

anna (eng-runtime): Example tuning config (will expand in appendix):
```yaml
run_id: nova-cloudx-2146-tuneA
model: open-ggml-13B-v3
quant: q5_k
kernel_flags: [fused_kv, block_sparse_attention]
batch_sizes: [1,16,64]
seq_len: 4096
power_sample_interval: 0.5s
artifact_tag: nova-cloudx-2146
```

kevin (infra): Note: make sure all timestamps are unix ms in metrics. Prom scrape interval = 2s for active runs. Logs will be routed to s3://redwood-bench-archives/nova-cloudx-2146/ and archived after 30d.

maddie (partnerships): Legal note: any co-branded "up to X perf/W" claim needs exact test text and methodology included. We'll loop in legal after the draft (week 4). Marketing: want a short exec summary + 1-page technical appendix.

ryan (eng-ml): Schedule a recorded run review with partner engineers once stability runs complete. We'll capture p95 curves, throughput vs batch curves, and perf/W waterfall.

josh (nova-engineer): Agree. We'll also attach per-run fan-speed telemetry and the power rail labels.

maddie (partnerships): Action items (owners & due-dates):
- anna: tuning appendix + initial config (due +9 days)
- kevin: rack + prom endpoints + s3 path (due +3 days)
- josh: SSO engineer list + sensor mapping (due +2 days)
- sana: CloudX marketplace metadata checklist + registry access (due +5 days)
- ryan: deterministic prompt set + quality scripts (due +7 days)
- carla: SI runbook template (due +4 days)

carla (SI): ack, will post template here when ready.

bench-bot: retention policy applied: active-run logs stored 30d, short-term metrics in influx for 14d, archived to s3 thereafter.

maddie (partnerships): We'll stand up 30-min syncs starting next Monday. I'll send calendar invites. Please post any infra hiccups or regression results here. Thanks all! :rocket:
